sources.title: Mahjong(g) Before Mahjong(g) — The Mahjong Tile Set

notes: 麻将发明人传说众多（含郑和等），均缺乏实证。较稳妥的看法是十九世纪后期由马吊、纸牌等博戏在江浙闽沿海定型，宁波常被当作重要传播中心，但福州等地亦有早期牌具记载，精确发明人与年份仍有争议。
notes_en: Many inventor legends (including Zheng He) lack evidence. A safer view is that mid–late nineteenth-century card and tile games along the Zhejiang–Fujian coast coalesced into mahjong; Ningbo is often named as a spread centre, but early sets are also attested elsewhere, so inventor and exact year remain disputed.
summary_zh: 麻将约于十九世纪后期在中国东南沿海定型，宁波常被视作重要中心；发明人传说很多，精确年份仍有争议。
summary_en: Mahjong took recognizable form in late-nineteenth-century southeast China, often linked to Ningbo. Inventor legends are many; the exact year remains disputed.
